resources.string: Your university day. In one place.
Your USOS timetable, grades and changes — start with a quick setup or explore the demo.
The app has no shared key. Your key and secret stay only in encrypted storage on this phone.
You enter your password only on the USOS website in your browser. After approving access you return to the app automatically.
1. Create a key on the university website
Under “Sign up for an API key”, enter a name (e.g. “My USOS Checker”) and your email, then submit the form.
2. Copy Consumer Key and Consumer Secret
Copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret. On the next screen one tap pastes both and opens sign-in.
No form or no keys? Ask your university’s USOS support or try the demo.
